scope: Resumable EVAL, source LOAD and compiled artifact LOAD in an opt-in dual core. Application drivers and Bordeaux Threads remain separate work.

implementation.entry: Inside an execution context, EVAL compiles the original top-level HIR into a resumable thunk and invokes it through Lisp FUNCALL. Ordinary startup stays synchronous.
implementation.semantics: Keep EVAL-WHEN, sequential top-level macro expansion, local macro/declaration environments and the null lexical EVAL environment. Invocation temporaries are private; load-time values initialize once per generated entry.
implementation.artifacts: Opt-in COMPILE-FILE serializes FUNCALL around the generated JS entry. LOAD can suspend without process-local handles or the original source.

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:resumable && npm --prefix tests run test:resumable

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

browserAssertions.reproduction: Concatenate performance/resumable.lisp, resumable/checks.lisp, callbacks.lisp, scheduler.lisp, eval.lisp and alexandria-checks.lisp. Run probe.mjs alexandria REPORT CHECKS --browser valtan-resumable --after-load=AFTER. AFTER concatenates scheduler-checks.mjs and eval-checks.mjs and awaits both verifiers; pass {fileCompilation:false} to verifyResumableEval.
